title: Browse private staff venue media from Library
purpose: Let staff inspect uploaded venue Photos with useful metadata and originals and remove an unwanted row through existing soft deletion.
success_outcome: Library opens an authorized venue/date media table; thumbnails or truthful placeholders link to native originals, metadata is safe and per-row soft deletion respects current ownership and CSRF.

evidence_required: FT-012-AC-008 RED: the Library has no venue Media journey or authenticated media table/list/thumbnail/original boundary; GREEN: the same seeded venue/date browser and API probe excludes admission-revision no_faces and returns every other eligible active row, including pending/processing/failed or missing state with placeholders when thumbnails are unavailable, with persisted metadata, correct UTC+7 bounds and admission thumbnail or placeholder, native original bytes and successful CSRF soft deletion; decisive comparison: current-source preimplementation and postimplementation results for the same disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO fixtures, with byte hashes/dimensions and persisted visibility comparison; artifact: redacted results, playwright cli transcript and screenshots under .tasks/TASK-119-T3-FT-012-W3/.

FT-012-AC-008 / REQ-INV-002 private delivery RED: the requested delivery boundary is absent before implementation, so authorized and denied behavior is not implemented; GREEN: direct list/thumbnail/original requests recheck active session, venue and uploader, missing or revoked sessions yield 401, denied scope yields 403, and denied CSRF deletion changes no state; decisive comparison: allowed and denied role/session/CSRF matrix against disposable fixture IDs and object hashes, plus no protected keys/URLs in responses; artifact: authorization matrix and state comparison under .tasks/TASK-119-T3-FT-012-W3/.
anti_goals: No new per-photo hard delete, purge behavior, storage schema, derivative generation or metadata pipeline.
No participant Promo/QR contract changes, reprocessing, global date/search policy changes, frontend framework or saved-filter/pagination subsystem.

forbidden_scope: Live uploaded Photos and default/operator object prefixes: never delete or mutate them for proof.
Unrelated concurrent FT-006 search/date and QR changes; shared app restarts, production deployment and live service configuration.
Direct processing-state writes, Photo/original replacement, public bucket URLs and unauthenticated staff-media delivery.
stop_conditions: Accepted media scope cannot be implemented through inventory authorization and the processing-owned read projection.
Proof would require mutating operator data or restarting a shared runtime rather than isolated disposable fixtures.

constraints: Primary owner is inventory at src/face_moment/inventory/; HTTP and backend composition remain thin adapters. Processing owns its admission-revision read projection at src/face_moment/processing/; no direct foreign writes.

Reuse Library /staff/photo-inventory (alias /staff/library), existing staff shell, motion-theme tokens, date_picker and StaffDateTime helpers; dates display dd.mm.yyyy and are interpreted in server UTC+7.

Select accepted_at by inclusive calendar dates, default today, exclude admission-revision no_faces rows while retaining all other eligible active rows (including pending, processing, failed and missing state), and do not alter authoritative visit_date or search filters.
Use persisted Photo metadata/original and the exact immutable admission revision thumbnail; do not substitute a later revision or fetch originals to populate table thumbnails.
Use playwright cli for real-browser Library → venue Media → date range → original separate-tab → disposable row delete proof; persist transcript and screenshots.

Current-source tests must use isolated PostgreSQL/MinIO with named disposable fixtures and cleanup. Reuse tests/disposable_postgresql.py where applicable; resolve fixture connection safely at execution.
Re-read shared files immediately before edits and preserve unrelated concurrent changes. Add the page to checked-in Caddy routing and verify through an isolated real HTTPS edge.
invariants: Staff private media never bypasses session, venue and immutable uploader authorization or exposes raw object keys.
This task adds no mutable persistence: read face_moment.photos and processing-owned admission state; the existing visibility mutation changes only Photo.is_active.
Historical FT-012 claims and done evidence remain with tasks 107–110; only AC-008 and its current security integration delta are proved here.
verification_targets: Persisted PostgreSQL fixtures at UTC+7 midnight edges prove inclusive From/To, same-day default, invalid/reversed 422, active and admission-revision no_faces filtering, retention of pending/processing/failed and missing-state rows, deterministic order and all matching rows across venues/uploaders.

Two revision rows with differing no_faces status and an absent admission row prove exact admission-thumbnail/status selection and no_faces exclusion from the table; missing references/objects yield a placeholder or 404 without on-read generation.
Private original/thumbnail reads prove native JPEG hash/dimensions, no-store on success/errors, missing/purged 404, truthful storage failure, and session/venue/uploader denials on direct requests.
Disposable soft-delete proof reads back Photo.is_active, preserves bytes/metadata/processing rows, rejects missing/mismatched CSRF without mutation, and removes the browser row only after success.

playwright cli on an isolated current-source HTTPS edge proves Library link, venue name, date entry/calendar, escaped metadata, empty/error state, thumbnail/placeholder and separate-tab original; record response paths/status/content types plus transcript/screenshots.

Focused architecture inspection proves inventory owns authorization/orchestration, processing only exposes its read projection, and transport/composition do not own business rules. No configured project-native architecture check was found; inspect the changed imports/owners directly.
